caption: The drawing depicts a single object—a vertical, ornate metal rod with decorative elements. At the top, there is a circular holder with an open, jagged-edge crown-like rim, supported by three short arms converging at the central rod. The central shaft is straight and thin, colored in metallic hues, primarily dark gray with subtle brownish and bluish tones suggesting shading and metal texture. Roughly two-thirds down from the top, two symmetrically placed, smaller horizontal protrusions are attached. The base of the rod features an elaborate design of multiple intertwined scrolls and spirals, all rendered in the same metallic color palette, creating a complex pattern. The entire composition is placed centrally on a plain, off-white or cream background with no other visible objects or additional context.
title: Stand for Incense Burner
